name: DuoFlow
tagline: 随倾斜变化的场景效果、横屏侧边 Dock 与可展开状态星环。
description: 双境为 iPhone 带来随倾斜变化的黑色渐变或折叠效果，仅改变当前画面，不切换 App 或桌面页。
横屏侧边 Dock、状态星环和原生切换器扩展分别设置，无需安装 TrollPadEx。
features: 黑色渐变与折叠动画可选，支持全屏、半屏及横竖屏独立设置
自然持握校准、平放拿起后恢复基准及手动重新校准
横屏侧边 Dock 的等比缩放、滚动、边距调整与主屏图标避让
App 内左滑呼出 Dock，Dock 与星环常驻分别控制
可展开的时间、电池和网络状态星环，支持位置调整与自动配色
主屏横屏、原生浮动 Dock、App 资料库与最近 App 独立设置
iPad 网格或 iPhone 卡片切换器选择，动画和网格缩放分别配置
同时启用 TrollPadEx 时交还重叠原生功能，保留双境的场景效果与侧边定制
显隐与 Dock 两个控制中心控件，英文、简体中文和繁体中文设置
设置页提供手动注销按钮，方便应用需要重新加载的选项
横屏桌面可隐藏搜索入口，左侧避让默认开启并支持 0～120 pt 额外距离
按真实生效范围分组的设置，四个位置滑块均支持直接输入数值
usage: 安装后手动注销一次；在“设置 → 双境”分别启用需要的功能，并在控制中心设置中添加两个双境控件。
在“主屏幕布局”中开启“允许主屏幕横屏”，再启用“横屏侧边程序坞”；App 内从右边缘向左滑呼出。原生程序坞选项适用于竖屏和横屏。
保持自然持握启用场景效果，需要时点“重新校准倾斜基准”。
修改主屏横屏、浮动 Dock 或切换器样式后，可点按设置页右上角或底部的“注销”按钮。
TrollPadEx 已启用时，在它的设置中调整重叠原生选项；停用它并注销后，双境可独立接管。
左侧避让默认开启，距离 0 为系统安全区基准；增大数值增加左侧留白，关闭开关会保留距离。搜索显隐和避让距离修改即时生效。
notice: 部分功能默认关闭，需分别启用。最低安装版本不等于所有功能均已验证；iOS 15/16、iOS 26 全功能及真机第三方共存验证尚未完成。

changes: 修正 iOS 17 横屏桌面的搜索按钮位置，新增横屏隐藏搜索选项，保留下拉搜索。
新增横屏桌面左侧避让开关与额外距离调节，默认按安全区避让，并修复调整后需重新转屏才生效的问题。
重新整理设置分组与生效范围说明，统一位置滑块的显示和数值输入样式。
新增设置页右上角及底部的注销按钮，方便应用需要重新加载的设置。
修复独立使用双境时关闭“在程序坞中显示 App 资源库”仍然显示的问题；同时启用 TrollPadEx 时继续交还其控制。
首次正式发布，提供随倾斜变化的黑色渐变与折叠动画，支持全屏、半屏和手动校准。
提供横屏侧边 Dock 与可展开状态星环，支持位置调整、自动配色和 App 内显隐。
提供独立 iPad App 切换器与原生 Dock 扩展选项；同时启用 TrollPadEx 时交还重叠功能。

en.name: DuoFlow
en.tagline: Tilt-driven scene effects, a landscape side Dock, and an expandable status ring.
description: DuoFlow adds tilt-driven black gradients or fold animation to the current iPhone screen without switching apps or Home Screen pages.
Configure the landscape side Dock, status ring, and native switcher options independently; TrollPadEx is optional.
features: Choose black gradients or fold animation with full/half-screen and separate portrait/landscape controls
Natural holding calibration, pickup baseline recovery, and manual recalibration
Landscape side Dock with proportional sizing, scrolling, margins, and Home Screen icon avoidance
Swipe left from the right edge to reveal the in-app Dock; independent Dock and ring persistence
Expandable time, battery, and network status ring with positioning and adaptive colors
Independent landscape Home Screen, floating Dock, App Library, and recent-app options
Choose iPad grid or iPhone cards, with separate animation and grid-scaling controls
Overlapping native features defer to enabled TrollPadEx while DuoFlow effects and side customization remain available
Two Control Center modules and English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese settings
Manual Respring buttons in Settings to apply options that require a reload
Optional landscape Home Screen Search hiding, with default-on left clearance and 0–120 pt extra spacing
Settings grouped by actual scope, with direct numeric input on all four position sliders
usage: Respring after installing. Enable the desired features in Settings → DuoFlow and add both modules in Control Center settings.
Enable landscape support under Home Screen layout, then enable the landscape side Dock. Swipe left from the right edge to reveal it inside apps. Native Dock options apply in portrait and landscape.
Enable scene effects while holding the phone naturally; use Recalibrate when needed.
After changing landscape Home Screen, floating Dock, or switcher style, use Respring at the top right or bottom of Settings.
When TrollPadEx is enabled, configure overlapping native options there. Disable it and respring before using DuoFlow as their independent provider.

Left clearance starts enabled. A distance of 0 uses the system safe area; positive values add space, and turning it off keeps the saved distance. Search visibility and clearance changes apply immediately.
en.notice: Some features start disabled. The minimum installation version does not establish full feature coverage; complete iOS 15/16, iOS 26, and physical-device third-party coexistence testing remains pending.

changes: Corrected the landscape Home Screen Search button position on iOS 17 and added an option to hide it while keeping pull-down search.
Added landscape Home Screen left clearance with system safe area defaults and extra spacing; fixed changes requiring another rotation to apply.
Reorganized Settings with clearer option scopes and consistent position sliders with numeric input.
Added Respring buttons at the top right and bottom of Settings to apply options that require a reload.
Fixed the App Library remaining visible after its Dock switch was turned off in standalone DuoFlow; enabled TrollPadEx retains control of overlapping options.
Initial stable release with tilt-driven black gradients and fold animation, full- or half-screen effects, and manual recalibration.
Landscape side Dock and expandable status ring with positioning, adaptive colors, and in-app visibility controls.
Independent iPad App Switcher and native Dock options; overlapping features defer to TrollPadEx when both are enabled.
